objective: Ship GPT-6.2 Sol and its instruction family on the current T3 Code Pi Codex provider from the existing work.
scope: Reuse the relevant source, tests and documentation from ee2531f8.
constraints: Preserve GPT-6, 6.1 and unrelated model defaults. Special commit author behavior applies to Claude Code only. No native Codex host or questions.

criteria.text: The existing Pi Codex provider defaults to GPT-6.2 Sol and selects GPT-6.2 instructions for Sol and Astra
Older models, other providers and harness-specific authorship retain their intended behavior

result:
result: The existing Pi Codex route selects GPT-6.2 Sol at high effort and resolves the matching instructions from the package. Astra uses the same 6.2 guidance. The 6 and 6.1 routes retain their own guidance.
checks: The real installed Pi 1.5.0 RPC smoke used a synthetic sign-in and a local prompt observer before inference. The exact release PR passed the Linux, Windows and macOS matrix. The local repository verify on 79e43564 passed 3,758 tests with 3 platform skips.
evidence:
The existing Pi Codex provider defaults to GPT-6.2 Sol and selects GPT-6.2 instructions for Sol and Astra: The installed Pi RPC returned openai-codex/gpt-6.2-sol:high by default, identical GPT-6.2 guidance for Sol and Astra, and previous GPT-6 guidance for explicit GPT-6.1 Sol.
Older models, other providers and harness-specific authorship retain their intended behavior: The codex, prompts and VCS tests passed on the exact release tree. Pi's effective root prompt used normal Git and contained no special identity setup.
